description:
Join to apply for the Principal Data Engineer role at AB InBev

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Principal Data Engineer role at AB InBev

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the role:

The Principal Data Engineer will play a pivotal role in the technical leadership of data engineering projects, actively collaborating with data teams to identify and implement improvement opportunities. You'll be responsible for establishing architecture and quality standards, programming and monitoring pipeline routines, and validating code, dedicating at least 50% of your time to code reviews and technical evaluations. Beyond coding, your role will include mentoring developers on technical decisions, striving to optimize the team's "ways of working," and constantly identifying opportunities for improvement in the data environment and architecture. You'll work on designing and implementing scalable data pipelines and robust architectures, ensuring business demands are translated into efficient technical solutions. You'll also optimize existing pipelines, drive data collection strategies, and foster collaboration with cross-functional teams, in addition to contributing to data warehouse and data lake architecture.

What you'll do:

  • Lead technical aspects of data engineering projects, actively collaborating with data teams to identify and implement improvement opportunities.
  • Establish architecture and quality standards.
  • Program and monitor pipeline routines.
  • Validate code, dedicating at least 50% of your time to code reviews and technical evaluations.
  • Mentor developers on technical decisions, optimizing team's ways of working.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement in the data environment and architecture.
  • Design and implement scalable data pipelines and robust architectures, ensuring business demands are translated into efficient technical solutions.
  • Optimize existing pipelines and drive data collection strategies.
  • Foster collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Contribute to data warehouse and data lake architecture.

What you'll need:

  • University degree in computing-related fields (e.g., Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Systems Analysis and Development).
  • Proven experience as a Data Engineer with strong technical leadership.
  • Advanced SQL proficiency (hard skills).
  • Strong command of Python and Spark.
  • Experience with Big Data environments.
  • Proficiency in Cloud platforms (AWS , Azure ).
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks .
  • Solid understanding of both SQL and NoSQL database technologies.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline and workflow management tools (e.g., Apache Airflow , Databricks Workflow).
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Proactive and self-directed approach.
  • Passion for building and optimizing data systems.

description:
Job description

HOSPITAL CARE

Em 2017, fundamos a Hospital Care com o objetivo claro de transformar o cenário da saúde suplementar no Brasil.

Nosso foco é estabelecer redes abrangentes de serviços de saúde, começando pela aquisição de hospitais privados de alta complexidade e expandindo de maneira orgânica. Essas redes, que chamamos de “Hubs”, conectam-se a diversos ativos, formando um ecossistema completo de serviços de saúde, desde laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos, até hospitais de alta complexidade.

Buscamos, através desta união tornar o sistema justo para todos os envolvidos, oferecendo aos pacientes tratamentos focados no seu bem estar, para as operadoras de saúde valores justos e sem desperdícios, aos colaboradores reconhecimento digno e aos investidores retornos sustentáveis, favorecendo toda a cadeia por meio de gestão otimizada e eficiente.

Atuamos para melhorar o acesso a saúde como um todo e nossas ações são orientadas para sermos a melhor rede de saúde privada do Brasil e para fortalecer o sistema de saúde brasileiro, promovendo o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas.

Atualmente, contamos com 5Hubsoperacionais nas regiões Sul eSudeste,compondo uma rede com9 hospitais, mais de 1.300 leitos, 7.500 colaboradores e 13 mil médicos associados, além de duas operadoras de saúde.

#vemserhospitalcare #vemparahospitalcare #vemserhc #jeitodeserhc #jeitodeserhospitalcare



Main responsibilities

Missão do cargo:

Responsável pela Coordenação do ambiente de Infraestrutura de T.I., abrangendo o ambiente on-premise e Cloud, corporativo e em todas localidades.

Garantir a escalabilidade e disponibilidade do ambiente de tecnologia para suportar as áreas de negócio, através de projetos e ações alinhadas a estratégia da companhia.

Sua missão é coordenar as ações, projetos e equipes multidisciplinares para elevar a confiabilidade dos serviços de T.I., através de melhoria contínua na infraestrutura essencial, assim como nos ambientes e soluções para sustentação e apoio ao negócio.

  • Irá coordenar a implantação de melhorias, mudanças, ações corretivas e requisições de serviços para elevar a confiabilidade na arquitetura dos ambientes de tecnologia.
  • Será responsável pela interface junto aos fornecedores de sustentação e implementação de soluções de infraestrutura, assim como pelo planejamento, controle e execução de projetos, garantindo a confiabilidade dos serviços de TI em todas as localidades.
  • Executar o gerenciamento de recursos humanos da equipe interna e/ou fornecedores da área de Infraestrutura de T.I. por meio de KPIs e SLAs.
  • Executar o planejamento e priorização das atividades da equipe de Infraestrutura, fazendo interface com as áreas de negócio.
  • Definir e planejar ações de melhoria para os serviços de infraestrutura de TI, garantindo a disponibilidade, confidencialidade, integridade e escalabilidade do ambiente tecnológico.
  • Coordenar ações e garantir a atuação da equipe e fornecedores através das metodologias e frameworks como ITIL e COBIT, abrangendo escritório corporativo e demais localidades.
  • Será responsável pelo design, planejamento e execução de projetos relacionados aos ambientes de Servidores, Armazenamento, Backup, Virtualização, Cloud, Office 365, Active Direcoty, e demais ambientes correlacionados a infraestrutura de TI, garantindo a atualização tecnológica desses ambientes.
  • Planejar e controlar prazos e custos na gestão de projetos de infraestrutura de TI, envolvendo equipes multidisciplinares e fornecedores.

  • Irá atuar no desenho e definição das estratégias de contingência e Disaster Recovery para os principais serviços de TI, assim como desempenhar funções relacionadas a arquitetura dos ambientes, sua documentação e estratégias de Cloud.

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
About the job Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

Must Haves
  • 5+ years experience in commercial iOS development ;
  • Proficiency in Objective-C, Swift , and modern iOS APIs , as well as experience using Apple development tools (Xcode , Instruments, etc);
  • Prior experience working on the library upgrades or migrations between libraries;
  • Experience with either AFNetworking or Alamofire ;
  • Demonstrated proficiency integrating with HTTP & Socket data APIs;
  • Self-driven engineer with strong grasp in delivering and presenting results in Agile manner;
  • Excellent communication skills with experience collaborating with multiple stakeholders;

Descrição das atividades e atuação previstas para o cargo de Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho, com foco em inspeções, treinamento, prevenção de acidentes e conformidade com normas de segurança.

Responsabilidades
  • Promover inspeções nos locais de trabalho, identificando condições perigosas, tomando as providências necessárias para eliminar as situações de risco, bem como treinar e conscientizar os funcionários quanto a atitudes de segurança no trabalho.
  • Preparar programas de treinamento sobre segurança do trabalho, incluindo programas de conscientização e divulgação de normas de segurança, visando ao desenvolvimento de uma atitude preventiva nos funcionários quanto à segurança do trabalho.
  • Determinar a utilização pelo trabalhador dos equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI), bem como inspecionar os equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio, quando às condições assim o exigirem, visando à redução dos riscos e à segurança e integridade física do trabalhador.
  • Colaborar nos projetos de modificações prediais ou de novas instalações da empresa, acompanhando a execução para garantir a correta utilização dos dispositivos de segurança.
  • Pesquisar e analisar as causas de doenças ocupacionais, através de levantamento de dados, visando à adoção de medidas para prevenção de doenças.
  • Promover campanhas, palestras e outros meios de divulgação de normas de segurança e higiene do trabalho, bem como para informar e conscientizar o trabalhador, através de cartazes, avisos, reuniões, palestras, visando ao acompanhamento e avaliação das atividades desenvolvidas.
  • Colaborar com a CIPA em seus programas, estudos e observações e proposições, visando adotar soluções corretivas e preventivas a fim de reduzir acidentes do trabalho.
  • Preparar programas de treinamento, administração de trabalho, segurança e meio ambiente do trabalho, analisando suas causas e gravidade, visando à adoção de medidas de prevenção de doenças ocupacionais e acidentes de trabalho.
  • Prestar assessoria à SIPAT, organizando as atividades e recursos necessários.
  • Avaliar os casos de acidente de trabalho, acompanhando-os até seu encerramento para recebimento de atendimento médico adequado.
  • Realizar inspeções nos locais de trabalho, identificando condições perigosas, tomando todas as providências necessárias para eliminar as situações de risco, bem como treinar e conscientizar os funcionários quanto a atitudes de segurança no trabalho.
  • Adentrar à câmara fria para realizar inspeção e controle dos procedimentos internos de acordo com a legislação. Formação: Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho completo. Vivência hospitalar.

A Animaltec é o laboratório veterinário referência em Campinas e região. São mais de 25 anos atendendo com toda dedicação e cuidado os nossos pets e tutores e oferecendo os laudos mais fidedignos para os veterinários parceiros.

Seria um diferencial muito grande:

  • Residência, mestrado ou experiência comprovada em Anatomia Patológica;

Se você é um profissional dedicado e entusiasmado, apaixonado por cuidar da saúde e bem estar dos animais, esta é uma excelente oportunidade para você. Junte-se a nós e faça parte dessa equipe comprometida e dedicada em fornecer o melhor diagnóstico veterinário!

Solventum enables better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in technology marketing, automation, or platform integration with proven experience in digital marketing and technology automation.
  • Hands-on knowledge of tools such as Infobip, Twilio, HubSpot, Salesforce, Eloqua, among others.
  • Experience in implementing chatbots and generative AI solutions.
  • Fluent in English

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed include:

  • Demonstrable achievements applying generative artificial intelligence in digital environments to enhance customer experience.
  • Evidence of positive impact on process efficiency and commercial value creation through technology.
  • Ability to translate business needs into effective technological solutions.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and project management skills.
  • Proven experience in coordinating multidisciplinary teams.
  • Ability to work in dynamic environments, managing multiple priorities with a results-oriented approach.

Work location: Hybrid Eligible
Travel: May include up to 35% (domestic/international)

Solventum is an equal opportunities employer and will not discriminate against any candidate based on their race, color, age, religion, gender, sexual orientation, identity or expression, nationality, or disability.

title: Validation Specialist
description:
Validation Specialist

A certified B Corp, OPTEL is one of the world's leading providers of traceability systems. Its mission is to use its innovative technologies to create a better world through responsible capitalism. The company's renowned solutions guarantee the quality of healthcare products and help combat the counterfeiting of drugs and medical devices around the world. OPTEL also adapts its technologies to different sectors—from healthcare to smart manufacturing and beyond—all of which can benefit from global traceability. OPTEL's expertise will enable various industries to measure, inspect, control, and track a wide variety of items to improve product quality and ensure more responsible use of resources.

Summary

The Validation Specialist is responsible for creating and updating validation documents (internal protocols, Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), Change Controls) to ensure that OPTEL systems comply with industry standards. This role requires strong expertise in documentation as well as the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and clients to ensure compliance, quality, and project reliability.

Please submit your resume in English.

Responsibilities

Validation Documentation and Management:

  • Develop and maintain standardized validation templates that comply with industry standards and regulatory requirements (GAMP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11).
  • Review and interpret system updates (new releases, patches) to assess their impact on validation documents.
  • Produce validation documents for clients based on functional and design specifications of projects.
  • Execute internal validation protocols as needed to ensure system functionality and compliance.

Risk Analysis and Quality Improvement:

  • Actively participate in risk assessments to identify validation-related issues and define necessary mitigation plans.
  • Identify root causes of validation nonconformities and deploy corrective actions with a focus on continuous quality improvement.

Collaboration and Expertise:

  • Coordinate with various internal departments to deliver validation documentation at key project milestones.
  • Advise internal teams and clients on best practices and validation strategies.
  • Work in collaboration with the Quality Assurance (QA) team to ensure compliance with internal and regulatory standards, including participation in internal and external audits.
  • Perform any other related tasks associated with validation processes.
Required Skills
  • College diploma in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience in system validation/testing or technical writing.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English required.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel). Rigor, analytical mindset, and attention to detail. Ability to collaborate effectively in a team and communicate with stakeholders at all levels. Strong curiosity and willingness to learn and adopt new technologies, especially artificial intelligence.

Advantages and benefits

  • Flexible work schedules;
  • Remote working mode;
  • Competitive compensation;
  • Healthcare plan;
  • Life Insurance;
  • Meal allowance (Ticket);
  • Wellhub.

  • Cumprir e promover as políticas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (HSE) da Sanofi em relação à equipe, incluindo o Programa de Segurança Viária, com objetivo de prevenir acidentes, evitar riscos à saúde, promover o bem-estar dos colaboradores e reduzir impactos ambientais.
  • Apoiar a estratégia e as iniciativas de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão para assegurar que todos os colaboradores e parceiros sejam tratados com respeito e recebam oportunidades iguais.
Sobre você
  • Experiência: Experiência em Gestão de Categorias e Strategic Sourcing.
  • Competências técnicas e pessoais: A posição requer um profissional de sourcing que possa desenvolver relacionamentos dentro e entre as diferentes linhas de negócios e em toda a organização de compras; forte conhecimento dos processos de RFx (RFI/RFP/RFQ); histórico comprovado na liderança de negociações comerciais e jurídicas importantes; forte compreensão de contratos legais, incluindo acordos de nível de serviço, acordos de preço fixo ou fórmula para materiais diretos; experiência em ferramentas de eSourcing e eProcurement (SAP/ERP); trabalho em equipe com excelentes habilidades interpessoais, de networking e comunicação; conhecimento e experiência na gestão de projetos e contratos locais; conhecimento intermediário de finanças e análise de custos.
  • Formação acadêmica: Graduação preferencialmente em Engenharia, Administração de Empresas ou Finanças; pós-graduação (preferencialmente em Engenharia, Administração de Empresas ou Finanças).
  • Línguas: Fluente em Inglês.
Por que nos escolher?

A Medley, unidade de negócios de genéricos da Sanofi, tem como foco democratizar o acesso à saúde no Brasil, desenvolvendo soluções voltadas principalmente para cardiologia, saúde feminina, doenças do sistema nervoso central e gastroenterologia. Há mais de 29 anos, oferecemos medicamentos de qualidade a milhares de brasileiros. A eficácia da Medley em produzir medicamentos genéricos é reconhecida e premiada, pois seguimos critérios de qualidade e rigor científico para oferecer o melhor para a saúde dos nossos consumidores.

Uma das nossas prioridades é melhorar a experiência das pessoas em suas jornadas de saúde, oferecendo conteúdos relevantes, campanhas educativas e serviços de apoio. Eficaz em tudo que faz, a Medley é patrocinadora do Comitê Olímpico do Brasil e apoia o esporte e a saúde dos brasileiros.

Persiga o Progresso. Descubra o Extraordinário.

O progresso não seria possível sem as pessoas; pessoas de diferentes origens, em diferentes locais, desempenhando cargos diferentes, mas todas unidas por um objetivo comum: o desejo de fazer milagres acontecerem. Você pode se tornar uma dessas pessoas. Procure a mudança, acolha novas ideias e explore todas as oportunidades que temos para oferecer. Persiga o progresso e descubra o extraordinário conosco.

Na Sanofi, oferecemos as mesmas oportunidades a todos, sem olhar raça, cor, ascendência, religião, sexo, nacionalidade, orientação sexual, idade, cidadania, estado civil, deficiência ou identidade de gênero.

Join to apply for the PROJECT MANAGER (PM): Engineer with industrial background - Frontmatec role at Action for Talent

The Project Manager has the responsibility to ensure customer satisfaction by delivering projects as per contracts scope of work, on schedule, with quality and within budget.

  • Ensure clear communication of project status, progress, changes, potential risks, issues and alternate solutions on a timely basis.
  • Once an order has been received, coordinate with the sales manager and sales engineer, the project’s information handover, ensuring all necessary information is available for the project development and execution.
  • Define projects’ objectives, scope of work, deliverables, performance guarantees and ensure they are known & agreed with internal stakeholders and aligned with customer needs and expectations.
  • Develop a detailed project schedule, including milestones and deadlines. Monitor progress and adjust timelines as needed to ensure timely completion.
  • Manage the project budget in line with the target Sales gross margin, including cost estimation, tracking, monitoring and reporting progress and estimated final gross margin. Ensure expenditures are aligned with budget constraints.
  • Manage communications and ensure the right information is distributed to the right stakeholders at proper time (clarifications, progress, etc.).
  • Ensure required changes to the original quote (cost, schedule & scope) are approved by the customer prior to manufacturing and the change order process is followed and fully complied.
  • Plan and coordinate across business units or entities, FMT stakeholders, as well as with major external contractors and vendors
  • Ensure the project deliverables (hardware and software) are met in accordance with internal and external deadlines and/or commitments made.
  • Monitor projects’ financials with operations & conduct financials follow ups & risk analysis with internal stakeholders.
  • Prepare projects monthly progress meetings, risk mitigation plans, financials reports and update internal stakeholders and management.
  • Resolve project issues through innovative solutions that will meet customer needs.
  • Plan and coordinate FAT/SAT and approve changes if required.
  • Work with the Installation team to plan and manage the installation, start-up and commissioning, ensuring all participants are trained, informed and fully comply with health & safety policies and regulations.
  • Obtain clients’ acceptance certificate signature after projects performance guarantees are met and coordinate the After Sales handover meeting is held at the customers’ job site with attendance of the SESO department and the customer project team.
  • Request and approve start-up and warranty activities.
  • Prior project closure, ensure all contractual obligations are met and that the customer is satisfied with the project completion final
  • Coordinate lessons learned or postmortem meeting to share projects findings during its execution. Develop The Lessons Learned report and ensure it is distributed among the company departments with the aim of continuous improvement.
  • Provide mentoring on project management and organization dynamics when applicable with new project managers hired by the company.
  • Knowledge of an integrated management system (Microsoft Dynamics AX an asset)
  • Knowledge of 2D and 3D software (Autocad and Inventor an asset)
  • Be able to make Gantt charts and identify critical paths.
  • Master the office suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, SharePoint)
  • Ability to simultaneously drive and manage several projects of various type.
  • Basic mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic and electrical knowledge.
  • Advanced written and spoken English skills.
  • Portuguese skills considered an asset.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification an asset.
  • Good knowledge of sanitary and safety standards in food processing or pharma facilities.

Training & Experience

  • Hold a BAC in engineering combined with several years of experience or any other combination of relevant training and experience.
  • Experience in customer service.
